ContentType.name: ImageVariantSet
ContentType.Description: One owner-bound image generation under the project's ImageAssets branch. Sealed sets are immutable.

Field.name: OwnerContent
Field.Description: Exactly one Timeline, MediaItem or BookMediaItem in this project; enforced by the handler.

Field.name: SourceContents
Field.Description: One to four distinct readable project media sources; a media owner is its own sole source. Enforced by the handler.

Field.name: GenerationId
Field.Description: Canonical UUID matching this generation's folder name.

Field.name: Manifest
Field.Description: Versioned JSON, at most 16 KiB UTF-8. Binary hashes, dimensions and complete child set are checked when sealing.

Field.name: Sealed
Field.Description: One-way immutable generation seal, validated by the backend before persistence.
